definitions: Quantifiable characteristics or properties of an object, system, or phenomenon that can be observed and assigned a value.
Features or qualities that can be objectively assessed, counted, or otherwise measured using a defined scale or method.
examples: The measurable attributes of the product included its weight, dimensions, and power consumption.
For effective project management, identifying the measurable attributes of success is crucial.
Scientists focused on the measurable attributes of the new material, such as its tensile strength and conductivity.
